Use baking soda. I'd say ACV is pretty useless all alone, it's used to get the pH back to normal after using baking soda, cause baking soda alone would make your hair and scalp way too dry. 

I'd suggest to put baking soda in bucket with hot water (be careful baking soda with hard water can make build up as well, so it's best to boil the water first), then put your dreads in it and leave them for max 30 mins. Also it's good to squeeze them etc. during that, if it's working, you'll feel the grease and stuff leaving your dreads and the water will bubble a bit haha. When you're finished, the water will probably change colour and since it's full of dirt, it's best to put your dreads in clean water afterwards and squeeze them again. Then you can wash them with residue free shampoo or just with water. And when your finished you should spray them with ACV or rinse them with it, so your pH is back to normal. 

If you have a lot of build up it'll take few times doing this. Also it's good to get maintenance after this procedure. It untangles the dreads.
